units: <cite ref="Mishnah Parah 11:9">Par. XI, 9</cite> <he>מְפַסְּגוֹ ואוגדו</he> he severs the stalks of hyssop and ties them; <he>פְּסָגוֹ ולא אגדו</he> if he severed, but failed to tie them.

senses.gloss: (denom. of פְּסִיגָה) to cut off sprays, to thin.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 119b:19">B. Kam. 119ᵇ</cite> <he>מְפַסְּגֵי אילנות ומפסגי גפנים</he> (Ms. F. <he>ומפסיקי</he>; Ar. <he>ומפסקי</he>) those hired to thin trees or vines; (Tosef. ib. XI, 18 <he>מפסקי גפנים</he> only).
M. Kat. 3ᵃ אין מְפַסְּגִין באילן you must not thin trees (during the festive week; Rashi: support the branches); a. e.—
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 2:28">Tosef. B. Mets. II, 28</cite>, v. infra.

senses.gloss: to cut one’s way through branches, pass through woods, vineyards &c., trespass; to lead through thickets &c.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 81b:12">B. Kam. 81ᵇ</cite> <he>התועה … מַפְסִיג ויורד מפסיג ועולה וכ׳</he> if one loses his way in vineyards, he may cut his way through up and down &c.; <he>הרואה … מפסיג וכ׳</he> he who sees a fellowman lost in vineyards, may make a way for him … until he brings him &c.; <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 2:28">Tosef. B. Mets. II, 28</cite> <he>מְפַסְּגוֹ בשדות וכ׳</he> may lead him through fields and vineyards.
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 2:28">Ib.</cite> <he>הוא עצמו … מפסיג וכ׳</he> ed. Zuck. (ed. <he>מפסג</he>) he who is lost himself may make his way &c.
